narrative: Builders on Hugging Face shipped 6,874 new Spaces this week against 7,146 the week before, a change of −3.8%, and 24,237 new models against 25,072, a change of −3.3%. Chat and assistants remains the largest named use case at 1,057 Spaces, while document AI saw the sharpest pullback of the named categories at −18.7%. On technique, vision-language reached 7.2% of new Spaces and tool use 3.6%, both up on the prior week; on audience, consumer-facing work leads at 11.3% and e-commerce and retail climbed to 4.8%. A residual bucket of 2,071 unclassified-purpose Spaces and 11,700 models in an unresolved family limit how far any single reading goes.
